name: Timeline of Elysium
summary: Historical eras, dated events, and the population series from the Neolithic to the founding of the Concord.

units.date: Elysian years; negative values are BE (Before the Era), positive are EY. There is no year 0.

eras.name: Deep time
eras.summary: Emergence and planetary dispersal of the Elysian species.

eras.name: The Alcyon Neolithic
eras.summary: Agriculture and the first cooperative water institutions in the Sirocc Basin.

eras.name: Cities and the Classical Era
eras.summary: Urbanism, writing, metallurgy, natural philosophy, and the Concord of Nine Cities.

eras.name: The Long Reach
eras.summary: Thalassari maritime expansion; first planetary contact network, with epidemic and extractive costs.

eras.name: The Vail Awakening
eras.summary: Industrialization in Auroria, driven by the co-location of Vail Spine ores and coal.

eras.name: The Integration
eras.summary: Planetary economic coupling without planetary institutions; the structural cause of the Long Emergency.

eras.name: The Long Emergency
eras.summary: A 78-year cascade of climate, famine, war, plague, and near-catastrophe; about 610 million excess deaths.

eras.name: The Consolidation
eras.summary: Institution-building, two withdrawal crises resolved without force, and the Abolition.

eras.name: The Ecological Settlement
eras.summary: Fossil combustion phased out and ecological limits written into the Charter.

eras.name: The Fusion Transition
eras.summary: Commercial fusion and the material precondition for the modern Concord.

eras.name: The Outward Turn
eras.summary: Orbital industry and the first Kalyra installations, driven by Constrained List scarcity.

eras.name: The Long Maintenance
eras.summary: The current era: no founding, no transition, no war — a civilization whose central project is keeping itself excellent.

events.name: Anatomically modern Elysians
events.summary: Modern Elysians appear in eastern Meridia.

events.name: The Myriad Isles settled
events.summary: First deliberate open-ocean voyaging on Elysium.

events.name: Veydra reached
events.summary: Last continent occupied; thin settlement leaves it available as a scientific commons.

events.name: Alcyon agriculture begins
events.summary: Flood-cycle farming in a desert river valley produces the planet's first large surpluses.

events.name: The Alcyon flow-share attested
events.summary: Rotating irrigation allocation; oldest continuous institution on Elysium and the ancestor of the 8-day week.

events.name: Ilvaret founded
events.summary: The first city, on the lower Alcyon.

events.name: Writing invented
events.summary: Administrative tallies of flow-share allocations.

events.name: The Meridian Leagues
events.summary: Bronze-analogue metallurgy from Cindral ores and the first city-state leagues.

events.name: Collapse of Ilvaret
events.summary: A 3,500-year-old civilization ends in eleven years of low water; the formative memory of Elysian culture.

events.name: Circumference of Elysium measured
events.summary: Classical natural philosophy establishes the planet's size accurately.

events.name: The Concord of Nine Cities
events.summary: A failed defensive league that gave the modern planetary state its political vocabulary and its name.

events.name: Movable-type printing
events.summary: Printing in the Meridian Leagues.

events.name: Epidemics of the Long Reach
events.summary: Contact-borne disease kills an estimated 40% of the Myriad Isles population.

events.name: Industrialization begins
events.summary: Steam power in the Vail Spine coalfields; Auroria industrializes first.

events.name: CO2 passes 400 ppm
events.summary: Atmospheric carbon dioxide crosses 400 ppm during the Integration.

events.name: CO2 passes 500 ppm
events.summary: Atmospheric carbon dioxide crosses 500 ppm.

events.name: The Long Summer begins
events.summary: CO2 passes 560 ppm; monsoon variability doubles and the cascade begins.

events.name: Annual reef bleaching begins
events.summary: Stonebloom bleaching becomes annual; Amarant fisheries begin to fail.

events.name: CO2 peaks at 610 ppm
events.summary: Peak atmospheric carbon dioxide; +2.9 C above pre-industrial.

events.name: The Phosphorus Famine
events.summary: A fertiliser supply collapse kills 210 million; the origin of Concord nutrient-loop doctrine.

events.name: The Amarant War
events.summary: Elandris and Auroria fight over fisheries and shipping lanes; the fishery collapsed anyway.

events.name: Sea-level commitment recognised
events.summary: Veydran Ice Cap margin loss accelerates; 0.9 m of committed sea-level rise acknowledged.

events.name: The Sirocc War
events.summary: Lithium and water; the shortest and most destructive war of the Long Emergency.

events.name: The Kessander Plague
events.summary: An engineered pathogen released by a non-state group; 340 million dead.

events.name: The Cassian Incident
events.summary: An automated warning system escalates a sensor fault to launch-ready status; catastrophe averted in 90 seconds by one officer's refusal. The most-taught event in Elysian history.

events.name: The Thalassar Accord
events.summary: First binding planetary treaty, on fisheries only — and it held.

events.name: The Verdanne Compact
events.summary: First enforceable carbon limits, agreed between the Isles and Meridia.

events.name: The Meridian Convention opens
events.summary: Four years, 1,100 delegates, published deliberation and mandatory minority reports.

events.name: The Concord Charter ratified
events.summary: Simultaneous planetary referendum; in force at the northward equinox of EY 1.

events.name: The withdrawal crises
events.summary: Two regions attempt withdrawal in EY 22 and EY 31; both resolved by negotiation and amendment, not force.

events.name: The Abolition
events.summary: Verified dismantling of all strategic weapons completed.

events.name: Fossil combustion phase-out complete
events.summary: End of fossil extraction for combustion; origin of retained-carbon doctrine.

events.name: Carbon corridor entrenched
events.summary: Ecological limits written into the Charter as constitutional, not legislative.

events.name: First commercial fusion
events.summary: First net-positive commercial fusion power.

events.name: Grid transition complete
events.summary: Fusion-anchored planetary grid completed.

events.name: The Corran Scandal
events.summary: A regional procurement network captured its own auditors for eleven years; detected by a transparency requirement its architects had opposed.

events.name: First Kalyra installations
events.summary: Permanent presence established on the major moon.

events.name: CO2 returns to the corridor
events.summary: 122 years of managed decline bring atmospheric CO2 back inside the constitutional band.

events.name: The Emergency of EY 233
events.summary: Emergency powers extended twice beyond their legal basis; ended by judicial order and the executive's resignation.

events.name: The Serrance Storm Failure
events.summary: 4,100 dead in a cyclone the forecast predicted correctly and the evacuation system did not act on.

events.name: Bible reference date
events.summary: The present of the Civilization Bible: EY 412, Calenth 16.

populationNote: Present-day population and all demographic structure are canonized in hist.demographics (Phase 3B).
